criteria: Copy Cat cards are marked for reuse in a separate app. Each mark is on the question plus its answer options. Post covers are context only, and a spicy cover does not retag a clearly nonsexual question. Blank slides and app-promo slides are not questions and are not marked. sexual: the card asks about sex, sexual acts, arousal, sexual history, or kink. flirty: teasing, coy, or sensual tension, including kissing and attraction, without an explicit sex act. both: explicitly sexual and also teasing or flirtatious. ambiguous: more than one reading is reasonable, or the text is too garbled to judge; these stay out of the combined selection for review. neutral: everything else, including friendship, generic personal questions, and nonsexual romance. Filter either kind with sexualOrFlirty, which is true only for sexual, flirty, and both.
